purpose: Receptor decision-threshold selection on validation predictions, applied once to the test partition. Motivated by HER2 positive-class recall at the default 0.5 threshold.

protocol.selection_partition: validation only; test labels not used for selection
protocol.tie_break: threshold nearest 0.50, then the smaller threshold
protocol.application_criterion: HER2 unconditionally; any other receptor task only if its validation balanced-accuracy gain is at least 0.02
protocol.retraining: none; the frozen checkpoints were not modified

caveats.threshold_free_metrics: Thresholding cannot change ROC-AUC or average precision. Any improvement below is a movement along the existing curve, not a better model.
caveats.validation_size: Thresholds are selected on 163 validation patients, of which the HER2-positive count is small. A threshold selected on so few positives is itself high-variance and may not transfer.
caveats.no_significance_test: No hypothesis test or confidence interval was computed for any threshold difference.

test.skipped: The pre-declared application criterion was not met on validation, so the test partition was not re-scored at a new threshold for this task.

threshold_free_metrics_unchanged.note: ROC-AUC and average precision rank patients and do not depend on the threshold. They are identical at every threshold above; moving the threshold only chooses a point on the same curve.

selection.application_reason: HER2 motivated the analysis and is applied unconditionally
